name: @fleet/simulator
description: Deterministic multi-vendor telemetry producer: emits raw Vendor A, B and C wire payloads over HTTP ingest for adapter, freshness, demonstration and load testing.
_runtime: Runs on plain node, not tsx, and is correct only while this package imports no workspace package (ADR 9 § Implications). The day it imports @fleet/contracts, dev and start must move to tsx in the same change, or it fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on a .js specifier nothing emits.
